examples.en: I am a student. I read old words. Read, and I will teach you! Teacher, what is this word? It is an old word, and your fathers spoke it.

source.name: coinage
source.note: Agent noun in -tōr 'teacher' to the causative doḱéyeti 'teach', with the causative's o-grade root (Lat. doctor, to doceō). Inherited -tōr nouns take the e-grade root (wékʷtōr), but the e-grade *déḱtōr would be 'taker, receiver' (to deḱ- 'take'); the o-grade is kept to tie the noun to the causative sense.
